description: 12 facts explicitly scoped to a window ('while I was at X', 'during the freeze') that later closes. Probes ask about the current state after the window ends; a stale answer means the memory kept treating the time-boxed fact as still true.

writes.text: While I worked at Meridian Corp, my manager was Tom Reyes.
During the two-week standing-desk trial in March, I worked standing all day.
During the December code freeze, no PRs were merged to main.
For the duration of ReactConf, I had an all-access speaker badge.
While debugging the outage, I used a temporary admin API key.
While my car was in the shop, I drove a rental.
While I was on parental leave, Marcus covered my on-call shifts.
During the closed beta, the new editor was gated behind a feature flag only I could see.
For the Q1 crunch, we brought on a contractor, Ravi, to help with mobile.
During the migration, the old domain temporarily redirected to a maintenance page.
During the summer trial, standup moved to 9am.
During the office renovation, I hot-desked wherever was free.
Cleared out a backlog of stale notifications today.
Since joining Northwind, my manager is Dana Okafor.
The trial ended; I went back to sitting at a regular desk.
The freeze lifted in January; PRs merge to main normally again.
ReactConf ended; my badge access expired with the conference.
The incident closed and the temporary admin API key was revoked.
Got my car back from the shop; back to driving my own car.
Wrote up the postmortem for last week's outage.
I'm back from leave and covering my own on-call shifts again.
The new editor went GA; the feature flag was removed and everyone has it now.
Q1 ended and Ravi's contract wrapped; mobile is back to just the core team.
Migration finished; the old domain now redirects straight to the new app, not a maintenance page.
The summer trial ended; standup is back to its usual 10am slot.
The renovation finished; I have my own assigned desk again, desk 14.
Updated the onboarding doc with the new repo layout.

probes.question: Am I working standing or sitting right now?
Are PRs currently being merged to main?
must_not_contain: no PRs were merged to main

probes.question: Do I currently have speaker badge access?
Do I have an admin API key right now?
expected: temporary admin API key was revoked
must_not_contain: I used a temporary admin API key

probes.question: What car am I driving currently?
Who covers my on-call shifts these days?
Is the new editor still behind a feature flag?
must_not_contain: gated behind a feature flag only I could see

probes.question: Is Ravi still working on mobile?
expected: back to just the core team

probes.question: Where does the old domain redirect to now?
expected: redirects straight to the new app

probes.question: Do I have my own assigned desk?
